column1: By- Law - Regarding Stone Quarries and Stone Pits
THIS  is  to  notify  that  I,  Dhamma  Dissanayake,  Governor  of  the  Sabaragamuwa  Province  has  approved  the  by-law
regarding  maintenance  of  Stone  Quarries  and  Stone  Pits  within  authoritative  area  of  Weligepola  Pradeshiya  Sabha,
prepared by the Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha by virtue of powers vested in it under section 122 read with section 126 of
Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 and passed at its general meeting held on 01.07.2019, by virtue of powers vested
under section 123(1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act read with section 2 of Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act,
No.  12  of  1989,  and  it  will  be  effective  within authoritative  area  of  Weligepola    Pradeshiya  Sabha  from  the  date  this
notification is published in the Gazette.
